name: ASM-028 USB-C hub dock assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact USB-C hub/dock with metal body, repeated USB-A ports, expansion ports, integrated cable, controller chip, LEDs, and rubber feet.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact USB-C hub/dock assembly with a slim rectangular body, top lid, front row of USB ports, rear HDMI/SD/Ethernet style ports, integrated USB-C cable and plug, internal controller chip, status LEDs, and underside rubber feet. Keep the model generic and robust with simple primitives.
assumptions: This is a generic hub/dock benchmark and does not model proprietary branding, logos, or exact connector standards.
Ports are represented as positive connector/socket blocks for topology robustness rather than fragile cutouts.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
